title: Scoped Correspondence Formalism (SCF) — formal correspondence contracts between mathematical models, with an independently verified library
description:
A Python library and research methodology for stating formal correspondences between mathematical models across domains, under explicit assumptions, domains and error bounds, each backed by an independently reproducible verification suite.

It covers dynamical systems, information theory (including directed information and information decomposition), thermodynamics and viability theory, together with typed scope and composition contracts, exact interval and identifiability certificates, finite causal abstraction and transport, weighted conformal calibration, and synthetic measurement-model pilots. The pilots are muonium gravity and adaptive modular networks.

Results keep evidence kind and empirical status as separate fields. Negative and mixed results are reported as such.

Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem. Source, documentation, review history and release notes: github.com/GenesisAeon/scoped-correspondence-formalism.
